title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Member Rate for Special Order Damage Allowances on Paid-in-Full Programs
content:
For members of Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards, the damage allowance on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program paid in full at order is figured at a member rate set by the membership's qualifying spend.

**Clause.** The member rate depends on the customer's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership: an active membership whose qualifying spend this program year is at least 25000.00 gives a member rate of 13 percent; an active membership whose qualifying spend this program year is at least 10000.00 but below 25000.00 gives 11.5 percent; otherwise the member rate is the program's damage allowance percentage.

The member rate is the percentage of the delivered price at which the damage allowance is figured.

## Records read

The customer's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership: its status and its qualifying spend in the current program year.

## Rate by membership record

| Membership status | Qualifying spend this program year | Member rate |
|---|---|---|
| active | 25000.00 or more | 13 percent |
| active | 10000.00 to 24999.99 | 11.5 percent |
| active | below 10000.00 | the program's damage allowance percentage |
| pending verification, suspended or closed | any | the program's damage allowance percentage |
| no membership | — | the program's damage allowance percentage |

For the paid-in-full programs that percentage is 10 for Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise, 10 for Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring and 0 for Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings.

## Boundary figures (hypothetical active memberships)

| Qualifying spend | Member rate |
|---|---|
| 25000.00 | 13 |
| 24999.99 | 11.5 |
| 10000.00 | 11.5 |
| 9999.99 | program percentage |
